objective: Build the governed qualification-control layer for the 28 implemented external API providers without conflating IMPLEMENTED with QUALIFIED.

rulesConsidered: IMPLEMENTED and QUALIFIED are separate lifecycle states.
External providers remain replaceable resources, not truth or execution authorities.
Metered and destructive provider calls require explicit human authorization.
Provider secrets must not enter evidence, logs, prompts or repository content.

notes: Runtime provider credentials are environment-injected only.
Evidence is normalized and sanitized; raw provider bodies are excluded.
Secret-bearing query parameters are redacted before evidence exposure.
No provider authority boundaries were expanded.

changes: Added qualification profiles and provider-specific probe paths for all 28 registry providers.
Added zero-network safe configuration mode and explicit live/metered/destructive guards.
Added visual materialization and audio physical verification evidence.
Added explicit metered LLM inference gate; model discovery alone cannot qualify inference.
Added manual GitHub Actions qualification workflow and evidence artifact.
Reconciled stale VidWords/Hugging Face lifecycle assertions in external API tests.
verificationPlan: Require Team Change Gate and repository CI before merge.
After merge, execute single-provider live qualification runs using explicit credentials and authorization.
Update the #184 provider disposition ledger only from actual run evidence.
notes: This PR does not claim any provider is QUALIFIED.
Issue #184 remains open until every provider has an explicit evidence-backed disposition.
